prompt: Marta paid for a year of a language app, but after two months her speaking has not improved and she dreads opening it. She keeps using it only because she paid. What is the best reasoning?

options.text: The payment makes the app more effective the longer she uses it
She must finish the year, otherwise the payment was wasted
Switching methods proves the first choice was foolish
The money is already spent either way, so she should choose the method that best builds speaking from now on

explanation: That is the sunk cost trap: a past payment should not dictate future time. The forward-looking question is which method actually practises speaking, regardless of what was paid.
